retirement_age.notes: Minimum retirement ages set by the 2019 pension reform: 65 for men and 62 for women. Statutory is set to the higher value (men). Transitional rules for people insured before the reform were not checked in this run.

offices.office: Head of state and head of government
offices.title: President

open_questions: Date 2026-10-25 is the presidential runoff. The first round was held on 2026-10-04; per Bloomberg and CNBC, the incumbent President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro advanced to the runoff. Re-check after 2026-10-25 for the result and the new holder.
Exact end date of the current presidential term (term_ends) was not confirmed from a source in this run; left null.
Transitional pension rules (for people insured before the 2019 reform) not verified; only the permanent minimum ages (65 men / 62 women) are recorded.
Source for retirement age (Georgetown Center for Retirement Initiatives) is a secondary reference, not an official Brazilian pension authority page; an official INSS/gov.br source should be added.
